content: Preventing hospital admissions and readmissions is a critical aspect of diabetes management. The American Diabetes Association (ADA) emphasizes the importance of addressing risk factors to reduce these occurrences. Age plays a significant role in determining the likelihood of hospitalization and readmission in individuals with diabetes. Older adults, in particular, are at an increased risk due to the presence of additional health complications and age-related physiological changes that may exacerbate their condition.
